reports.title: Laura McRory
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Mrs McRory was employed by the North East London Foundation Trust
concerns.hazard: employment at North East London Foundation Trust

concerns.quote: need for a clear process to be in place when NELFT staff require mental health care and express reservations about sharing information with colleagues
concerns.hazard: lack of clear process for mental health care

concerns.quote: an adequate safety plan in place on discharge
system in place for staff to be promptly referred to a different Trust where they present with mental health difficulties and request services from a different Trust
concerns.hazard: lack of prompt referral system to other Trusts

reports.title: Carol Robinson: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

promises.quote: we attach a detailed action plan addressing the concerns raised by you.
promises.summary: Attach detailed action plan addressing concerns

concerns.quote: Mrs Robinson did not receive a medical review by a doctor within the Home Treatment Team prior to her discharge back to the care of her GP on the 25th April 2022.
concerns.hazard: lack of medical review before discharge

concerns.quote: Mrs Robinson did not receive a comprehensive risk assessment prior to her discharge from the Home Treatment Team on the 25th April 2022.
concerns.hazard: absence of comprehensive risk assessment before discharge

concerns.quote: There was no multi-disciplinary team discussion to ensure a safe community plan following discharge from the Home Treatment Team. There was no communication with regard to the withdrawal of the Home Treatment Team's input, with the domiciliary care agency or family of Mrs Robinson.
concerns.hazard: lack of multidisciplinary planning and communication after discharge

links.explanation: Both reports highlight deficiencies in discharge planning that could compromise safety. The earlier report focuses on lacking safety plans for staff mental health discharge, while the later report notes absent multidisciplinary discussion for patient discharge safety.
links.earlier_quote: The report also did not to any extent consider whether there was an adequate safety plan in place on discharge.
links.later_quote: There was no multi-disciplinary team discussion to ensure a safe community plan following discharge from the Home Treatment Team.
